envelope.description: Add sc4 BuildTaskOutcome as the status-discriminated union (a2 reshape)

body.title: Add sc4 BuildTaskOutcome as the status-discriminated union (a2 reshape)
body.summary: Define BuildTaskOutcome = BuildTaskReached | BuildTaskUnreached per the winning a2 alternative and the accompanying hld.amendmentProposal (sharedContract.fieldRemove testVerdict, breaking:true). The reached arm (status 'completed' | 'failed') REQUIRES a daemon-produced testVerdict: BuildTestVerdict plus filesTouched and attempts; the unreached arm (status 'blocked' | 'not-reached') carries none of them because nothing ran. This encodes sc4's load-bearing invariant — testVerdict/filesTouched are daemon-produced, never self-reported — at the type level so a blocked/not-reached Task literally has no field in which a fabricated verdict could sit (migration step 2).
acceptanceChecks: BuildTaskOutcome is exported as `BuildTaskReached | BuildTaskUnreached`; the reached arm (status 'completed' | 'failed') requires testVerdict: BuildTestVerdict plus filesTouched and attempts, and the unreached arm (status 'blocked' | 'not-reached') declares none of those fields.
Constructing a 'blocked'/'not-reached' outcome carrying a testVerdict or filesTouched is a compile error, proving the daemon-produced invariant is enforced by the union rather than only documented.

tests.name: schemas: BuildTaskOutcome union invariant — a reached outcome ('completed'|'failed') requires testVerdict/filesTouched/attempts while a 'blocked'/'not-reached' outcome carrying testVerdict or filesTouched is a compile error
